name: Iddo
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: “Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo”: this is where the class is, Zechariah’s leadership. They “prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel”.

The elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo; and they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet.

note.label: Zechariah 1: Turn Ye Unto Me, and I Will Turn Unto You
